hard_class_invariants.CACP-CHAIN-0: ConvergenceLedger HMAC-SHA-256 chained; verified before every append
hard_class_invariants.CACP-APPEND-0: ConvergenceLedger append-only; no record removal permitted
hard_class_invariants.CACP-IMMUT-0: Sealed ConvergenceProofs raise ImmutabilityViolation on re-write
hard_class_invariants.CACP-SCOPE-0: Only valid ACI pipeline stage names accepted (CASL/CADE/CAPE/CAOE/CALI)
hard_class_invariants.CACP-ORIGIN-0: Proof must reference at least one non-empty ACI cycle record
hard_class_invariants.CACP-CYCLE-0: Complete ACI cycle requires all 5 pipeline stages present
hard_class_invariants.CACP-DETERM-0: Convergence score computation is deterministic; no randomness
hard_class_invariants.CACP-TREND-0: Trend must be IMPROVING/STABLE/DEGRADING; unknown raises TrendError
hard_class_invariants.CACP-HUMAN0-0: DEGRADING proof requires non-empty notified_by before acknowledgement
hard_class_invariants.CACP-AUDIT-0: Every aggregate/prove/acknowledge operation sealed in HMAC-chained audit log
hard_class_invariants.CACP-PROOF-0: Every ConvergenceProof carries HMAC-SHA-256 binding of all cycle inputs
